data.name: Janaanht
data.gender_notes: Janaanht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is beautiful and beloved, radiant and graceful, and full of love and kindness. The name Janaanht carries the meaning “Grace, beauty, love” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Janaanht usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty, love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is a source of joy and beauty in the world, and who embodies the qualities of love, kindness, and grace.
data.etymology: Janaanht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, beauty, love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Janaanht total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: جنانحت
in_arabic.meaning: جنانحت يعني الجنة والحنوتية في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: جنانحت هو اسم يعود إلى الجذور العربية، ويتألف من كلمتين: جنان وجنت. الجنان تعني الجنة في اللغة العربية، بينما الحنت تعني الحنو والرقة. يعتبر هذا الاسم ذا أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرتبط بالجنة والخير الكثير. كما أنه يوحي بالرقة واللطف، مما يجعله اسمًا محبوبًا لدى الكثيرين.

in_urdu.name: جنانحت
in_urdu.meaning: جنانحت کا مطلب جنت اور حنو کے ساتھ
in_urdu.long_meaning: جنانحت ایک عربی मूल کا نام ہے جو اردو میں بھی مستعمل ہے۔ اس نام کا مطلب ہے جنت اور حنو، جو اللہ تعالی کی رضا اور تقویٰ کی علامت ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے، جہاں یہ نام بچوں کو دی جانے والی اہم صفات جیسے نیکی، رحمت، اور تقویٰ کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जानान्हत
in_hindi.meaning: जानान्हत का अर्थ है स्वर्ग और सुकृति
in_hindi.long_meaning: जानान्हत एक अरबी मूल का नाम है जो भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रचलित है। इस नाम का अर्थ है स्वर्ग और सुकृति, जो ईश्वर की कृपा और भक्ति का प्रतीक है। यह नाम बच्चों को दी जाने वाली महत्वपूर्ण विशेषताओं जैसे कि अच्छाई, दया, और भक्ति का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।

in_pashto.name: جنانحت
in_pashto.meaning: جنانحت د جنت او حنو معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: جنانحت د پښتو ژبې يو نوم دی چې په افغانستان کې د مسلمانانو لخوا کارول کېږي. دغه نوم د جنت او حنو په معنی دی، کوم چې د الله تعالی د رضا او تقویٰ نښه ده. دا نوم د پښتنو په کلتور کې مهم دی، چیرته چې دا د نیکۍ، رحم، او تقویٰ استازیتوب کوي.

in_english.name: Janaanht
in_english.long_meaning: Janaanht is an Arabic-derived name that signifies 'paradise' (janan) and 'kindness' or 'compassion' (ht). Etymologically, it stems from the Arabic root 'j-n-n' which connotes the idea of paradise or heaven. This name holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing a person's aspiration for heavenly virtues and their commitment to benevolence. Historically, names like Janaanht have been used to express parents' hopes for their children's moral and spiritual well-being. Across Muslim cultures, it is valued for its positive connotations of piety, mercy, and righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Janaanht" represents the ideal of beauty and loveliness, reflecting an admiration for these qualities in Islamic culture. It may be given as a name for a daughter whose parents hope she will grow up to be a gracious, kind, and beautiful young woman. In traditional societies, naming ceremonies for babies were grand occasions where family and community gathered to celebrate the arrival of a new life. In such a context, the name Janaanht could serve as a reminder that beauty and kindness are important virtues to cherish and aspire towards.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual sense, the name Janaanht can be interpreted as a reminder of the love and kindness that Allah (God) has shown to humanity. It can also be seen as a reflection of the Prophet Muhammad's compassionate and loving character, which inspired his followers to emulate his example. By giving their child this name, parents may be encouraging them to cultivate a loving and compassionate heart, striving to be of service and kindness to others. Overall, the name Janaanht reflects a commitment to living a virtuous life rooted in love and kindness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Grace, beauty, love" symbolizes The one who is beautiful and beloved, radiant and graceful, and full of love and kindness.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Janaanht serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of grace, beauty, love.
